title: A giant icy world hiding beyond Pluto could be our sixth dwarf planet
caption:
Astronomers have spotted a massive icy body far beyond Pluto, named 2026 ED138. At roughly 1,000 km across it could join the tiny family of dwarf planets, if follow‑up measurements confirm its size. The Rubin Observatory’s deep‑sky survey made the discovery possible.

Source: Sciencedaily - A giant icy world hiding beyond Pluto could be our sixth dwarf planet

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261112230447.htm
